exposure: Breastfeeding practices (initiation, prelacteal feeding, colostrum feeding)
cohort: 121 mothers of infants aged 0-6 months in Mirzapur Upazilla, Bangladesh
finding: The prevalence of EBF in Mirzapur was 36%, with no significant associations found between EBF and most potential predictors, although there was some evidence of an association with cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery showed some evidence of an association with lower EBF rates.
